description: terrains/cliffs.lua at 8 m: tiers of cap rock over a softer base with amphitheatre re-entrants and chutes, a lower slope carved by stream power, sea cliffs and beaches, talus aprons. No heightmap reference exists for this family, so these are guards set from the rebuild: closed depressions 0.32 % of the land (2.75 % before the staged rebuild), no spikes past 85 degrees, walls kept (over 45 degrees on 9 % of the land) and scree at its angle of repose (5 % between 30 and 38 degrees).
